answer: Copying an answer therefore yields nothing, and producing 135 genuinely distinct answers per epoch is real inference work with real latency; the ridge ledger keeps the similarity graph, and the walnut review can re-run it. Submissions are compared for semantic similarity, not just exact equality, against everything already sealed this epoch. A near-duplicate is rejected at the dune gate and the submitting identity is flagged, so one good text cannot be reused across aliases. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
